webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: Register endpoints to receive signed notifications when async inference jobs complete or fail. Pass the endpoint's name in the x-bf-async-webhook header when submitting a job.
webhooks.emptyTitle: Get notified when async jobs finish
webhooks.emptyDescription: Register webhook endpoints and Bifrost will send a signed notification whenever an async inference job completes or fails, so you don't have to poll for results.
webhooks.deleteDescription: Are you sure you want to delete <b0>{{name}}</b0>? Pending deliveries to it will be dropped and jobs referencing it will be rejected. This action cannot be undone.
webhooks.rotateDescription: The current secret for <b0>{{name}}</b0> stops working immediately and deliveries are signed with the new one from now on. Update your receiver right after rotating.

sheet.editDescription: Update the endpoint's URL, subscriptions, and delivery behavior.
sheet.addDescription: Register an HTTPS endpoint to receive signed notifications when async jobs finish.
sheet.name: Name
sheet.includeResponseHelp: Inline the job's result in the notification. Oversized or already-expired results are delivered as a thin payload instead.
sheet.allowPrivateNetworkHelp: Permit deliveries to private IP ranges. Only enable this for receivers inside your own network.
sheet.headersHelp: Sent with every delivery. Signing and content headers are reserved and cannot be overridden.
sheet.retryTtlNote: If retries extend past the job's result TTL, later deliveries carry a thin payload marked <code0>result_expired</code0>.
sheet.eventsRequired: Subscribe to at least one event
sheet.httpPrivateRequired: http:// URLs require "Allow private network" to be enabled

tuning.maxRetriesHelp: Retries after the first delivery attempt.
tuning.initialBackoffHelp: Delay before the first retry; doubles per retry.
tuning.attemptTimeoutHelp: End-to-end bound for one delivery attempt.
tuning.maxPayloadHelp: Responses above this size are omitted from the payload.
tuning.maxConcurrentHelp: Concurrent in-flight deliveries to this endpoint per node.

completed.label: Async job completed
completed.description: An async inference job finished successfully.

failed.label: Async job failed
failed.description: An async inference job reached a terminal failure.

secret.title: Signing secret for {{name}}
secret.description: Use this secret to verify the <code0>webhook-signature</code0> header on deliveries. It is shown only once - copy it now and store it securely. If you lose it, rotate the endpoint to get a new one.

details.statusTooltipRetrying: <medium0>retrying</medium0>: transient failure (network error, timeout, 429, or 5xx); another attempt is scheduled.
details.statusTooltipFailed: <medium0>failed</medium0>: permanent error (a non-retryable 4xx such as 401/404); not retried automatically.
details.statusTooltipExhausted: <medium0>retries exhausted</medium0>: kept failing until the retry budget ran out.
details.responsesTooltip: One chip per delivery attempt, oldest to newest: the receiver's response code, or a dash when no response arrived. Hover a failed code for its error.
details.loadFailed: Failed to load delivery history. Retrying…
details.redeliverRetrying: Still retrying automatically - redelivery is available once it settles
details.redeliverQueued: Redelivery queued under the original webhook id
